title: Automating a Chaos Engineering Environment on AWS with Terraform and Gremlin
summary: A step-by-step tutorial: Terraform builds a throwaway VPC and one EC2 instance whose user data installs the Gremlin agent, you run a latency attack from the Gremlin web app and watch ping times rise by about 100 ms, then `terraform destroy` removes it all. Useful as a pattern for disposable chaos test environments; it is Gremlin’s own tutorial, last updated in 2018 and flagged by Gremlin as possibly out of date, and it hardcodes agent credentials in user data, which it says not to do long term.
